# laravel_cloud_dedicated_clusters (Data Source)

Lists dedicated clusters available to your organization, optionally filtered by region, type and status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_dedicated_clusters" "all" {}

# Filters match as substrings.
data "laravel_cloud_dedicated_clusters" "apps_us_east_2" {
  region = "us-east-2"
  type   = "applications"
  status = "active"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String) Only list clusters whose region contains this value, such as `us-east-2`. The API matches it as a substring.
- `status` (String) Only list clusters whose status contains this value, such as `active`. The API matches it as a substring.
- `type` (String) Only list clusters whose type contains this value, such as `applications`, `rds-databases` or `elasticache-clusters`. The API matches it as a substring.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) Available dedicated clusters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.
- `region` (String) Cluster region.
- `status` (String) Cluster status.
- `tenancy_type` (String) Tenancy type (shared, dedicated).
- `type` (String) Cluster type.
